project.idea: An open-source agent-facing companion that discovers robot datasets and descriptions through WarmHub, trains a local proof-of-concept world model, evaluates it with Rerun, and can later scale an approved run to RunPod.
project.audience: robotics practitioners and coding agents building world models for a specific robot
storyGoals: treat bencaunt/robot-datasets and bencaunt/robot-models as co-equal sources
make homogeneous and heterogeneous dataset mixtures explicit and reviewable
produce a small local MPS or CUDA proof of concept before paid remote compute
make every evaluation inspectable in Rerun with a registry-resolved robot description
turn newly discovered datasets into reusable manifests and adapters
constraints: source discovery and provenance through WarmHub wherever registry coverage exists
upstream payload bytes remain at attributed sources
uv owns Python environments and lockfiles
Rerun output is mandatory for evaluation
no paid RunPod action without a cost-bounded plan and explicit approval
no secret values in prompts, files, command arguments, logs, or generated plans

validationReceipts.detail: Live WarmHub reads found SO-ARM101, a pinned Apache-2.0 URDF description, and qb1t/so101_teleop_cubes with RGB, proprioception, joint-position state/actions, and passing source/license/schema assessments.
Official uv, Rerun, and RunPod documentation reviewed before writing commands and safety requirements.
uv lock resolved, three manifests validated, generated catalog and schemas were current, Ruff passed, and 9 tests passed.
uv run rwm warmhub discover SO-101 queried both first-class repos and returned current robot and dataset candidates.
The Rerun evaluator loaded the pinned SO-101 URDF package, preserved the provisional joint-mapping guard, and wrote a 19,320,690-byte evaluation recording.

reproduceSteps: uv run rwm warmhub discover SO-101
caveats: RunPod is plan-only until provisioning and teardown tests are implemented.
The first robot-dataset edge is alias-derived and requires user confirmation.
remainingHumanDecisions: approve the first data mixture and modalities
approve implementation of paid RunPod provisioning after local proof of concept
